Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
The new storyline allows playing these two vampires from groups 2 & 4
in same crypt. How exactly do their specials interact?

Nicomedes
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Group: 4
Capacity: 5
Disciplines: aus for nec vic
Sabbat Black Hand: Once each of your turns, Nicomedes may burn a blood
to shuffle your hand into your library (draw afterward).

Agaitas, The Scholar of Antiquities
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Group: 2
Capacity: 6
Disciplines: for AUS NEC
Sabbat: When you play a card, you may draw its replacement from your
prey's library instead of your own. Put the card drawn face-up in
front of you. It is still considered to be in your hand, to be played
or discarded as normal.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:

I'd say the card Agaitas retrieves from your prey's library isn't

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On May 14, 8:02 am, Whisker <moisander.mi...@gmail.com> wrote:
> The new storyline allows playing these two vampires from groups 2 & 4
> in same crypt. How exactly do their specials interact?

(You could also do this via Corruption, for example).

If you used Nic's special, the cards in your hand (including those on
the table from Agaitas) are shuffled into their owners' libraries.
Then you draw a new hand from your library.

# Cards that go into an ash heap, hand, or library always go into
their owner's ash heap, hand, or library. [RTR 19970425]

http://white-wolf.com/vtes/?line=rulings
